name: Magid Collaborator
author: magidcollaborator

sections.description:
Magid Collaborator brings AI-powered content creation directly into your WordPress admin. Powered by proprietary consumer intelligence, Collaborator helps your team produce on-brand, audience-informed content and publish it to WordPress — without leaving the dashboard.

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Content Creation: Turn proprietary consumer intelligence and your inputs into on-brand written content in minutes
  • Publish Without Leaving WordPress: Create, optimize, and publish content directly from the WordPress admin panel
  • Brand Voice Consistency: Maintain your brand voice across all content with AI-powered precision
  • Flexible Configuration: Choose post types and default status for created content
  • Role-Based Access: Administrators configure the connection, editors and authors create content
  • Secure Connection: Industry-standard encryption keeps your site and credentials safe
  • Activity Logging: Track all content creation activity for transparency and troubleshooting

How It Works

  1. Install: Install and activate Magid Collaborator on your WordPress site
  2. Connect: Enter your Collaborator API token in the setup wizard — the plugin handles the rest
  3. Create: Use Collaborator’s AI tools to produce audience-informed, on-brand content
  4. Publish: Send content to WordPress with a single click — posts are created instantly

Security

  • Encrypted & Authenticated: All communication between your site and Collaborator is encrypted and verified using industry-standard protocols
  • Automatic Key Management: The plugin generates and stores credentials securely — nothing to manage manually
  • Permission Controls: Only authorized users on your site can create and publish content

Requirements

  • WordPress 6.0 or higher
  • PHP 7.4 or higher
  • Active Collaborator account with API access

External Services

This plugin connects to the Collaborator service (https://collaborator.magid.com) to provide content creation and management features.

Service Information

  • Service Name: Collaborator
  • Service URL: https://collaborator.magid.com
  • Purpose: Provides an embedded interface for creating and managing WordPress posts from within the Collaborator platform
  • Data Transmitted: Post titles, content, status, and post type; HMAC authentication signatures
  • Terms of Service: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/terms
  • Privacy Policy: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/privacy

When Does This Plugin Contact External Services?

The plugin communicates with Collaborator in the following situations:

  1. Initial Setup: When you enter your API token in the setup wizard, the plugin generates HMAC keys and registers with the Collaborator API.
  2. Iframe Embedding: When editors access the Collaborator interface from within WordPress, an iframe loads content from https://collaborator.magid.com
  3. Post Creation: When you create a post through the Collaborator interface, the content is sent to your WordPress site via the REST API using HMAC authentication.

Data Handling

All communication between your WordPress site and Collaborator uses secure HMAC-SHA256 authentication. No personal data is transmitted to Collaborator beyond what is necessary for post creation. All API credentials are encrypted and stored securely in your WordPress database.

For detailed information about data handling and privacy, please review:
* Privacy Policy: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/privacy
* Terms of Service: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/terms

Privacy Policy

Magid Collaborator connects your WordPress site to the Collaborator platform. The plugin:

  • Stores auto-generated API credentials (API key and secret) encrypted with AES-256-CBC in your WordPress database
  • Does NOT store user passwords or Collaborator login credentials
  • Stores connection status and configuration settings locally
  • Logs activity data (action type, status, user ID, timestamps) locally for debugging
  • Does not collect or transmit any personal data to third parties
  • Does not use cookies or tracking mechanisms

All API authentication is handled via HMAC keys that are automatically generated and securely stored. For information about how Collaborator handles data, please refer to the Collaborator Privacy Policy at https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/privacy

Support

For support, feature requests, or bug reports, please visit:

  • Support Forum: https://wordpress.org/support/plugin/magid-collaborator/
  • Documentation: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/user-guide
  • Terms of Service: https://collaborator.magid.com/docs/wp-collaborator/terms

Credits

Developed by the Magid Collaborator Team.
sections.installation:
Automatic Installation

  1. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  2. Navigate to Plugins > Add New
  3. Search for “Magid Collaborator”
  4. Click “Install Now” and then “Activate”

Manual Installation

  1. Download the plugin ZIP file
  2. Log in to your WordPress admin panel
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin
  4. Choose the downloaded ZIP file and click “Install Now”
  5. Activate the plugin

Configuration

  1. Activate the Plugin:

    • After installation, the plugin is ready to use
    • No manual API key creation needed

  2. Connect to Collaborator:

    • In WordPress admin, go to Collaborator > Settings
    • Enter your Collaborator API token in the setup wizard
    • The plugin connects your site to Collaborator automatically

  3. Configure Preferences (optional):

    • Set your preferred post type (Post, Page, or Custom Post Types)
    • Set default post status (Draft, Pending, Publish, or Private)
    • Click “Save Changes”

  4. Start Using:

    • Go to Collaborator in the WordPress admin menu
    • Sign in to your Collaborator account through the embedded interface
    • Create content and publish to WordPress with one click

That’s it! All team members with Editor or Author roles can now create content through Collaborator and publish directly to WordPress.
sections.faq:
How do I set up the connection?

Install the plugin, then go to Collaborator > Settings. Enter your Collaborator API token in the setup wizard and the plugin takes care of the rest.

Who can use the Collaborator integration?

Editors, Authors, and Administrators can access the Collaborator interface. Only Administrators can configure the connection settings.

What post types are supported?

The plugin supports all registered post types in your WordPress installation, including custom post types. You can select the default post type in the settings.

Can I customize the post status?

Yes! In the plugin settings, you can choose the default status for created posts: Published, Draft, Pending Review, or Private.

Is my data secure?

Yes. All communication between your site and Collaborator is encrypted and authenticated using industry-standard protocols. Credentials are generated automatically and stored securely in your database. No user passwords are stored, and all requests are validated against your authorized domain.

What happens if I deactivate the plugin?

Deactivating the plugin will remove the Collaborator menu from your admin panel, but your configuration and logs will remain in the database. Posts created through Collaborator will remain unaffected.

What happens if I uninstall the plugin?

Uninstalling the plugin will completely remove all plugin data, including configuration, logs, and database tables. Posts created through the plugin will remain in your WordPress site.

Does this work with Gutenberg and Classic Editor?

Yes, the plugin is compatible with both Gutenberg and the Classic Editor.
